name: nordwind
description: Nordwind Sp. z o.o. — a Polish trading company: buys goods from suppliers into one warehouse, sells them to Polish customers, keeps statutory books in PLN.

customers.name: Kowalski i Wspólnicy sp. z o.o.

interview.answer: Our master data: the chart of accounts, the companies we deal with (ourselves, customers, suppliers), the catalogue items, the warehouse locations and the VAT rates each become their own master-data object; each company also carries its bank account number (IBAN) when we know it.

reference.description: Master data events become master-data objects.

rules.description: accounts
companies

VAT rates

citations: master data as records of their own

interview.answer: Every sales invoice we issue becomes a sales invoice document (the type sales_invoice): number, issue date, the seller and the buyer found by NIP, the net amount, the currency and the VAT rate code from the invoice. VAT is the net times the rate's percent divided by 100, rounded half up to the grosz; gross is net plus VAT; the due date is the issue date plus the payment days printed on the invoice; the status starts open and can later move to paid. The open amount starts at the gross and goes down as payments are matched; a partly paid invoice stays open, and a paid one is open again when its match is undone. Each sales invoice is posted in the book pl-stat: debit 201 with the gross, credit 700 with the net, credit 222 with the VAT.

reference.description: Sales invoices become documents with computed VAT and post to the statutory book.

rules.description: sales invoice documents with VAT computed and rounded
a sales invoice posts 201 gross / 700 net, 222 VAT

citations: ustawa o VAT art. 106e: kwoty podatku zaokrągla się do pełnych groszy

interview.answer: Every delivery gets one PZ document (goods received note; a new type named pz) with the supplier, the supplier's delivery document number, the warehouse location, the date and the currency. Each delivered item becomes a line of that PZ (a new type named pz_line) pointing at it, with the fields qty, price and value, the value being quantity times the unit price stated on the delivery. Every line moves that item's stock into the delivery's location and is posted in the book pl-stat at its value: debit 330, credit 300.

reference.description: A delivery becomes a PZ with valued lines; each line moves stock in and posts at its value.

rules.description: one PZ per delivery
one valued line per delivered item
each line moves stock in
each line posts Wn 330 / Ma 300 at its value

citations: zapasy w cenie nabycia: Wn 330 / Ma 300 (ustawa o rachunkowości art. 28)

interview.answer: A supplier's invoice becomes a purchase invoice document (the type purchase_invoice): number, invoice date, the supplier found by NIP, our own company as the owner, the net amount, the currency and the VAT rate code. VAT is the net times the rate's percent divided by 100, rounded half up to the grosz, and gross is net plus VAT; the status starts open and can later move to paid. The open amount starts at the gross and goes down as payments are matched; a partly paid invoice stays open, and a paid one is open again when its match is undone. Each purchase invoice is posted in the book pl-stat: debit 300 with the net, debit 221 with the VAT, credit 202 with the gross.

reference.description: Supplier invoices become purchase invoice documents with computed VAT and post to the statutory book.

rules.description: purchase invoice documents with VAT computed and rounded
a purchase invoice posts 300 net, 221 VAT / 202 gross

interview.answer: Goods issued from the warehouse become goods issue documents (the type goods_issue: item, location, quantity, date, reason) and every issue moves that item's stock out of its location.

reference.description: Goods issued become goods issue documents and move stock out.

rules.description: goods issue documents
an issue moves stock out

interview.answer: Every bank statement line becomes a bank line record (the type bank_line): date, amount, currency, direction, the title as its reference, the counterparty and its account, our account; its open amount starts at the amount, and its status starts open and moves to settled when nothing stays open. Money in is matched against the open sales invoices of the customer whose account it comes from, in this order: the invoice the title names; the named invoice up to 0.02 short or over, the difference written off to 755; an invoice of exactly that amount; the fewest invoices that add up to it, at most 4; the named invoice in part; otherwise the oldest open invoices as far as the money reaches. Money out is matched the same way against the open purchase invoices of the supplier whose account it goes to, without the tolerance. A match moves the open amounts of the invoices and of the line by what was allocated - paid, or settled, when nothing stays open - and records a settlement per invoice (the payment, the document type and id, the amount, the date). A tolerated difference becomes a matching difference record (kind, amount, currency, direction, account, date), and a short one is posted in the book pl-stat: debit the difference account, credit 201. What no step settles is shown side by side — the open lines and the open invoices — for a person to pair.

reference.description: Bank lines are matched against open invoices by the owner's policy; every match settles, records a settlement and writes off a tolerated difference.

rules.description: every bank statement line becomes a bank line record, open for its amount
money in is matched against the open sales invoices of the party whose account it names, by the owner's policy
money out is matched against the open purchase invoices of the party whose account it names, by the owner's policy
a match moves the open amount of each sales invoice it allocated; paid when nothing stays open
a match moves the open amount of each purchase invoice it allocated; paid when nothing stays open
a match moves the open amount of the bank line; settled when nothing stays open
a settlement per invoice a match allocated: the payment, the document, the amount, the date
a tolerated difference becomes a matching difference record
a short difference posts in pl-stat: debit the difference account, credit 201

interview.answer: Customer complaints are registered as complaint documents (number, customer, details). Every complaint opens a follow-up case: a new type named case, whose subject is the complaint number and whose status starts open and can later move to resolved.

a case per complaint

interview.answer: When a customer withdraws a complaint, its case is resolved.

reference.description: A withdrawal resolves the complaint's case.

rules.description: withdrawal resolves the case

interview.answer: A stock count of an item at a location records a stock level (a new type named stock_level) with the fields date, counted, book and difference: the count date, the counted quantity, the book quantity, which is the sum of that item's stock movements into the location minus those out of it, dated up to and including the count date, and the difference, counted minus book.

reference.description: A stock count records the counted and book quantities and their difference.

rules.description: book quantity as the sum of movements up to the count date

fields.book: =sum(m in objects(stock_movement, item, ref(item, sku, $.item)) where m.location = ref(location, code, $.location) and m.date <= $.date: if(m.direction = "in", m.qty, -m.qty))
fields.difference: =$.counted - sum(m in objects(stock_movement, item, ref(item, sku, $.item)) where m.location = ref(location, code, $.location) and m.date <= $.date: if(m.direction = "in", m.qty, -m.qty))

citations: inwentaryzacja: stan księgowy na dzień spisu a stan z natury (ustawa o rachunkowości art. 26)
